references.text: The Gibeonites prepared themselves with old bread and worn-out sacks as part of their deception to appear as travelers from a distant land.
The Gibeonites asked for a covenant with Joshua, which is the same request they expressed through their elders in verse 11.
Joshua made a covenant with them, just as they had requested through their elders.
Moses gave instructions to offer peace to distant cities before going to war, something the Gibeonites exploited by claiming they came from far away.
God forbade Israel from making covenants with the Canaanites and their gods, but the Gibeonites tricked Israel into breaking this command by lying about their origin.
Joseph's brothers prepared gifts before meeting him, similar to how the Gibeonites prepared provisions to meet the Israelites.
